description: A specialty clinic access director must choose which of two referred patients receives the clinic's only Monday heart-failure transition appointment and finalize the operational plan for that visit, with input from cardiology, utilization review, social work, and home-care coordination.

shared_context.S1: The heart-failure transition clinic has one new-patient appointment available on Monday at its downtown location.
shared_context.S2: Patient Alder and Patient Birch both have referrals for the clinic and are medically stable for outpatient evaluation.
shared_context.S3: Maya makes the final referral-priority decision and records the appointment plan.
shared_context.S4: The clinic's standard access huddle occurs before the Monday schedule is finalized, and Maya checks with cardiology, utilization review, social work, and home-care coordination for relevant scheduling and care requirements.

PF1.text: Dr. Chen reviewed Patient Alder's discharge summary and found that the cardiology team requires a transition-clinic visit within seven days of discharge to adjust the new regimen; Monday is the only available clinic visit inside that interval.

PF2.text: Patient Alder's insurer approved the transition-clinic evaluation, but the authorization expires Tuesday at 17:00; Patient Birch's referral has no active authorization on file.

PF3.text: Patient Alder's daughter can bring the patient only between 09:00 and 11:00 on Monday, and the daughter requested an Arabic interpreter for the visit; a 09:30 appointment is the only clinic time that fits both arrangements.

PF4.text: Patient Alder is being discharged with a portable oxygen concentrator, and the home-care supplier confirmed delivery to the patient's home by 07:00 Monday; the clinic's intake checklist requires that delivery before the patient attends the appointment.

acceptance_conditions: The Monday appointment must be assigned to Patient Alder because Monday is the only visit inside the required seven-day transition interval.
The appointment must be scheduled for 09:30 on Monday.
The authorization must be recorded as approved with an expiry of Tuesday at 17:00.
An Arabic interpreter must be arranged for the visit.
Oxygen delivery must be recorded as confirmed before the appointment.
A commitment to arrange the Arabic interpreter must be recorded.
The cardiology timing requirement must be cited as justification.

content_checks.C4: decisions['interpreter_language'] == 'Arabic' and any(c['type'] == 'interpreter_arrangement' and c['target'] == 'Patient Alder' for c in commitments)

provenance_checks.P1: 'PF1' in credited_facts and 'PF1' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF1' in revealed

decisive_facts.why: The seven-day cardiology requirement changes the assignment from an open choice between Alder and Birch to Patient Alder and supplies the specific justification that must be cited.
The authorization record changes from an unresolved coverage question to approved coverage with the exact Tuesday 17:00 expiration.
The daughter's 09:00-11:00 availability and Arabic-language request change the appointment to exactly Monday 09:30 and require an Arabic interpreter commitment.
The supplier's confirmation of delivery by 07:00 Monday changes the oxygen field from unverified to confirmed before the 09:30 clinic visit.
